record.summary: Parcel P15, the eastern of the three west Mission Bay Commons parcels (between 4th St and 3rd St), holds Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens mini golf, as OCII's November 14, 2024 update (PDF p.17 legend) labels its current uses. They began as interim uses (OCII's timeline gives 2017 for the P15 pilot), pending the Mission Bay Future Parks Project, which Rec and Park says will renovate parcels P12, P13 and P15 into a permanent park, with construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030 on Rec and Park's estimated schedule (expected dates, which differ by source). P12 and P13 have their own records.

notes.accuracy_caveat: The shape is approximate but its outer edge is real. The outer edge is OpenStreetMap way 446183018 (leisure=park, name 'Parklab', community-surveyed). The lines between the three parcels are not surveyed parcel lines: they are drawn at DataSF's official street centerlines for Merrimac St and 4th St, which are roadways across the strip, offset 6.8 m each side (checked on satellite imagery; at Merrimac St the paved crossing is only about 10-11 m wide with the centerline near its east edge, so the line on the P13 side falls about 2-3 m inside the community garden beds, leaving about 70-100 sq m of them out of P13), and the order of the parcels, P12 then P13 then P15 from west to east, is from OCII's November 14, 2024 update (PDF p.17), whose drawing is not to scale. This parcel is the easternmost of the three, between 4th St and the OSM outline's east end near 3rd St, about 4,450 sq m. The shape is not clipped to the street layer (street_clip_exempt): clipping a drawn outline against DataSF centerline buffers would cut P12 in two along DataSF's Long Bridge St segment, which crosses the soccer field where imagery shows no roadway, and would trim the north edges of P12 and P15, so the processed shape is the drawn one. This parcel has no Assessor lot of its own: Assessor lots 8732001 (1,415 sq m) and 8711005 (2,953 sq m), both active, each hold part of this parcel (about 19% and 45% of it; the parcel is about 61% and 68% of those lots), so neither lot is this parcel's own. The interim uses here are as OCII labels them (OCII's legend label "Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens"); they are interim pending the Mission Bay Future Parks Project, which is planned to redesign parcels P12, P13 and P15 into a permanent park (expected dates differ by source; see the record page).

open_questions: The schedule differs between sources and is not resolved: Rec and Park's project page gives "Construction begins, Late 2028" and "Open to the Public, Early 2030" but also says the remaining parks "are anticipated to be complete by 2028", and slide 9 of OCII's November 14, 2024 update reads "Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)" and "Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)". All of these are expected dates.

Which interim use on P15 started when is not settled: OCII's November 2024 timeline (slide 9) gives "MB Commons interim use pilots begin on P13 (2016), P15 (2017), P12 (2018)" and names no uses. Hoodline, published August 20, 2018, reports "San Francisco's first outdoor mini-golf course, Stagecoach Greens, is now open at 1379 4th St. in Mission Bay"; no source written after the event was found for the opening of Parklab Gardens, so it has no opening date here.

Which parcel Parklab Gardens sits on is given two ways by the same deck: the people-counts legend (PDF p.17) reads "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens", while a survey slide (PDF p.31) reads "P13 & P15: Food Truck Park with Outdoor Dining (SPARK Social SF & Parklab Gardens)". This record follows the legend.

No official parcel boundary was found for P15: The outline is the OpenStreetMap park strip named Parklab (way 446183018), cut at 4th St along DataSF's street centerline plus 6.8 m; the lines between parcels are drawn from OCII's November 2024 drawing (PDF pp.5 and 17), which is not to scale, not from a survey. This parcel has no Assessor lot of its own: lots 8732001 and 8711005 each hold part of P15 (about 19% and 45% of it), and P15 is about 61% and 68% of those lots. Its east end is as OpenStreetMap has it: about 10.6 m from the centerline of 3rd St and 3-4 m from that street's west curb.
The Rec and Park project page is undated and shows 'Project update, October 2026' alongside August 2025; the schedule on it may be revised.

The OCII November 2024 deck's timeline (slide 9) is an image with no text layer; it was read on 2026-10-12 from a rendering of the slide. It gives "Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)" and "Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)", which differ from Rec and Park's later page (construction beginning late 2028, opening early 2030).
